# H1 2026 close - CFO brief (R$)

Sources: `finance/ledger.csv` (86 postings), `finance/chart_of_accounts.csv`, `finance/cash_balance.txt`, board definitions in `finance/README.md`.

## Monthly P&L

| Month | Revenue | Gross margin | EBITDA | Net of financials |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-01 | 200,510.87 | 70.03% | -210,278.96 | -203,812.19 |
| 2026-02 | 216,328.06 | 70.29% | -212,300.08 | -205,001.69 |
| 2026-03 | 219,066.17 | 68.46% | -204,525.45 | -198,078.94 |
| 2026-04 | 238,163.26 | 70.24% | -196,950.65 | -189,670.28 |
| 2026-05 | 243,032.89 | 69.56% | -201,945.82 | -195,444.78 |
| 2026-06 | 272,391.57 | 72.41% | -192,968.22 | -187,346.57 |

Revenue = SaaS subscriptions + onboarding services + refunds/cancellations (net).
COGS = production cloud/GPUs + customer support. EBITDA = revenue + COGS + S&M + R&D + G&A (financial line excluded, see assumptions).

## Cash position and runway (board definition)

- Burn = average monthly negative EBITDA of last three closed months (Apr, May, Jun) = (196,950.65 + 201,945.82 + 192,968.22) / 3 = **R$ 197,288.23/month**.
- Latest closing cash balance (30/06/2026) = **R$ 1,847,350.40**.
- Runway = 1,847,350.40 / 197,288.23 = **9.36 months** (to roughly early April 2027 at current burn).

## Trends to present

- Revenue grew every month, +35.7% Jan to Jun (200.5k to 272.4k); June jump driven by SaaS subscriptions (224.9k -> 243.7k).
- Gross margin stable around 70%, improving to 72.4% in June; March dip (68.5%) due to refund/cancellation credits of R$ 6,814.15.
- EBITDA burn narrowed from ~210k to ~193k/month: revenue growth outpaced opex growth (opex up ~7% Jan to Jun vs revenue up ~36%).
- June cash balance fell R$ 461,837.60 vs 31/05 while the ledger shows a net P&L outflow of only R$ 187,346.57 - see flag below.

## Assumptions and flags

1. EBITDA excludes the financial line (investment income +59.3k H1; interest/IOF -19.7k H1). Board's burn definition is EBITDA-based, so this is what the runway reflects; net-of-financials burn would be ~190k/month and runway ~9.7 months.
2. Refunds (3.1.09) are booked net inside revenue, per the chart of accounts.
3. Cash balance taken from `cash_balance.txt` (latest close 30/06). The ledger P&L does not fully tie to the cash movement: May->June cash fell R$ 461.8k vs a ledger net of R$ 187.3k, implying ~R$ 274.5k of non-P&L cash outflow in June (possible financing, investing or timing items not in this ledger). CFO should confirm with accounting before the meeting; it does not change the board-defined burn or runway inputs.

## Key figures (machine-readable)

See `result.json`: revenue, gross_margin_pct, ebitda per month 2026-01..2026-06, burn, runway_months.
